name: Albania
spiritual_teacher: Bektashi Order / Sufism (Tirana is the world center of the Bektashi Sufi order, a tradition of mystical tolerance and freedom)
work_strategy: Remote (0% tax on small business and self-employed up to €120,000/year valid until end of 2029; Unique Permit for nomads)
it_market: Weak (Virtually no high-paying domestic market, local services only)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: €0 in year 1 (Unique Permit / Law 25/2022); from year 2, 15% PIT (€90–150/mo) or Person Fizik ~€148 fixed; UA FOP Single Tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Warm (Mediterranean, up to 300 sunny days, mild wet winter and hot dry summer)
nature: Top Sea + Alps (Two seas: Adriatic in the north, turquoise Ionian in the south; wild Albanian Alps)
english_level: Difficult (Youth in Tirana speak English/Italian; in provinces and government offices, Albanian only)
housing_rent: Cheapest (~€260–340 for a 1-bedroom near the sea in Vlora or Durres, cheapest real estate in Europe)

price_sources.summary: [Numbeo Vlore](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Vlore) (1-bedroom rent outside centre `~€337`, living/food/utilities excl. rent `~€599`, incl. utilities+internet `~€75`); heating — `CLIMATE_AND_HEATING_COSTS.md` (~€40–70 winter).
numbeo_mandatory_fields: Estimated monthly costs for a single person without rent (food, transport, basic household)
Basic utilities (Electricity, Heating, Cooling, Water, Garbage) + Internet (Broadband)

citizenship: 7 years (Requires continuous residence and passing a language test)
mortgage_expats: Unavailable (Banks do not issue loans to foreigners without permanent residency)
rent_to_buy: Rare (Direct interest-free installment plans from Albanian developers possible)

items: [Merrjep.al](https://www.merrjep.al/njoftimet/imobiliare/me-qira) — Albania's largest classifieds site (Vlora, Saranda, Durres, Tirana).
[Indomio.al](https://www.indomio.al/en/for-rent) — leading real estate portal in English and Albanian.

notes: **Strict conditions:** income `€600 / €750 / €800 / €1,000/mo` net after UA FOP Group 3; without opening *Person Fizik* (or with it in year 2); >1 year horizon, regardless of TP.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.legality_over_1y_no_tp: **Unique Permit for Digital Mobile Workers** (Art. 68 of Law 79/2021). Income threshold is only **32,000 ALL/mo (≈ €320/mo)** or a 300,000 ALL (≈ €3,000) deposit. Independent of TP or military registration; issued for 1 year, renewable.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.first_12_months: *Unique Permit* holders are not considered tax residents of Albania → **€0 local taxes on foreign income**.
year_2_plus: *Option A (without Person Fizik, personal foreign income declaration):* **15% PIT** (`€90 / €112.50 / €120 / €150/mo`).

*Option B (Person Fizik registration):* **0% PIT** up to 14M ALL/year (valid until 31.12.2029), but mandatory minimum social + health contributions on 50,000 ALL min wage = `11,500 ALL (23%) + 3,400 ALL (3.4%×2)` = **14,900 ALL/mo ≈ €148/mo** fixed.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.verdict: **Top-1 option independent of TP** for 1–2+ years and **best choice for 12 months** at any €600–1,000 income. In year 2+, profitable from €750–1,000 income.

legalization_and_residency.visa_free_stay: Ukrainian citizens with a biometric passport can legally stay in Albania without a residence permit until **March 30, 2027** (when applying for TRP, a bank statement of **€5,000+** may be requested; lawyer support from €300).
digital_nomad_requirements: Employment contract or freelance agreement with a foreign company.
Confirmed income from **~$9,800/year** *(note: Law 79/2021 specifies a 32,000 ALL/mo threshold, but in practice ~$9,800/year is often expected — verify for the specific application)*.
Rental agreement for at least **1 year**.
Police clearance certificate and proof of qualifications (diploma / certificates).
other_residency_grounds: *Sole proprietor / business:* registration in Albania, commercial lease/floor plan, 1-year residential lease, business plan, diploma, Albanian bank account, accountant.
*Real estate:* at least 50% ownership, title deed, area from 30 m² for 1 person (or 20 m²/person for a family), no minimum investment amount, passport valid ≥15 mo, proof of source of funds.
*Official employment:* employment contract with a local employer (permit arranged by employer), 1-year lease, diploma.
*Family reunification:* PRP after 5 years, citizenship after another 2 years.

rent_and_startup_costs.prices_and_entry_cost: rent starts from **€200/mo** (depends on location and condition). Standard move-in costs via a realtor: **1st month + 2 months deposit + 50% realtor fee** (e.g., at €550 rent, move-in costs €1,925).

supermarkets: *Big Market* (most popular chain, reasonable prices), *Conad* (Italian goods, above-average prices), *Eco Market*, *Spar*.
items: **Butcher shops (*Mise*):** fresh meat and poultry (free mincing/steak cutting on the spot).
**Markets (*Tregu*):** seasonal vegetables, fruits, greens, olives, homemade cheese 2–3x cheaper than supermarkets.
groceries_markets_living.seismic_risk: the country is seismically active — earthquakes occur (4.5 magnitude tremors recorded; last major one in Durres was 6.5). Worth considering when choosing floor and building year.
